architecture: Input Image (H,W,C) -> Encoder (CLIP/ResNet) -> Feature Map -> Fusion Module (Multi-scale) -> PDC (Pixel Dense Counter) -> Decoder -> Output (Count Map + Bounding Boxes)

modules.name: CountAnythingModel
modules.output_shape: dict: {'count_map': torch.Size([B, 1, H, W]), 'boxes': torch.Size([B, N, 4])}
modules.function: 主模型类，整合编码器、融合模块和PDC，输出计数图和边界框

modules.name: FeatureFusion
modules.function: 融合多尺度特征图，增强空间信息

modules.name: PDCLayer
modules.function: 像素级密集计数核心模块，生成密度图

modules.name: PixelDenseCounter
modules.function: 基于PDC的像素级计数头，输出最终密度图

modules.name: CountAnythingLoss
modules.input_shape: pred: torch.Size([B, 1, H, W]), target: torch.Size([B, 1, H, W])

modules.name: PDCLoss
modules.input_shape: pred: torch.Size([B, 1, H, W]), target: torch.Size([B, 1, H, W])
modules.function: PDC专用损失函数，优化像素级计数精度

modules.name: RSCLoss
modules.input_shape: pred_boxes: torch.Size([B, N, 4]), target_boxes: torch.Size([B, M, 4])
modules.function: 边界框回归与分类损失

modules.name: Trainer
modules.function: 训练循环控制器，管理数据加载、优化器和损失

modules.name: Matcher
modules.input_shape: pred_boxes: torch.Size([B, N, 4]), target_boxes: torch.Size([B, M, 4])
modules.function: 预测框与真实框的匹配逻辑

modules.name: CountingMeter
modules.function: 评估指标计算，统计MSE, MAE等

modules.name: PostProcessor
modules.function: 后处理，从密度图提取边界框
